fact: A report of September 2025 sets out a five-year strategy for institutionalising Earth observation-based crop monitoring and early warning within the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MADER) of Mozambique.
title: A strategy for sustainable capacity development in Earth observation-based crop monitoring and early warning systems in Mozambique: Tools, guidelines, and recommendations
publisher: ITC, University of Twente and GEOGLAM, for the World Bank
